name: Angeles City
scopeLimits: The UN WUP 2025 point is a settlement-population locator, not an official city boundary, property identity, or completeness statement. No owner, address, applicant, or tax data was requested or retained; no account credentials, CAPTCHA, or token was used. City Assessor paper/document procedures and FOI release are registry evidence, not an anonymous map or a citywide geometry source.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The City of Angeles lists a City Assessor service for certified copies of tax declarations. Its citizen charter requires a qualifying request with supporting title/interest documentation and a fee; national government FOI pages document cadastral-map requests/releases for Angeles. No public city parcel-vector service was identified.
